mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diydb.post(postCode, postCtCode, targetName, targetSubName, targetAuthor, targetThumbnail, memberId, memberNick, starCount, title, content, createOn, updateOn, openStatus) VALUES ( null, #{postCtcode}, #{targetName}, #{targetSubName}, #{targetAuthor}, #{targetThumbnail}, #{memberId}, #{memberNick}, #{starCount}, #{title}, #{content}, date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), null, "Y" );
mapper.select: select * from diydb.post where postCtCode = #{type} order by postcode DESC;

select targetName, targetAuthor, targetThumbnail, avg(starCount) as starCount, targetSubName, count(targetName) as cnt from diydb.post where postCtCode = #{postCtCode} group by targetName order by cnt desc LIMIT 5;
mapper.update: UPDATE diydb.post SET starcount = #{starCount}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updateOn = date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') WHERE postcode = #{postCode};
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM diydb.post WHERE targetName LIKE '%${search}%';
mapper.update: UPDATE diydb.post SET memberNick = '${param1}' WHERE postCode = #{param2};
